stem:
Diya learns that wind and rain break a rock into smaller pieces of the same rock material. No new substance forms.

What kind of change is this?

options.text: Physical change — the material stays the same substance.
Chemical change — no new substance forms.
Chemical change — the change is slow and natural.
Physical change — every natural change is physical.

teacher.key_rationale: Breaking rock into smaller pieces of the same substance is a physical change. Slow or natural does not decide the type.
